name: Revaz Vachnadze
headline: Years of symptoms before anyone checked his lungs
summary: Revaz smoked heavily for many years and went about a decade without treatment before he was finally diagnosed with COPD. He now calls for earlier diagnosis and for doctors to look at the whole person, not just their own speciality.
quote: If they had checked my lungs sooner
source: WHO Regional Office for Europe, June 2025

name: Jadhav
headline: COPD from a lifetime of cooking over an open fire
summary: Living on the outskirts of Nagpur, Jadhav has never smoked, yet one of her lungs is severely damaged. Her family has always cooked and heated water on wood or coal, with no access to clean cooking fuel.
quote: My lungs have become useless by cooking food on the open stove

name: Elina
headline: A COPD diagnosis in her twenties
summary: Elina was 26 when she learned she had emphysema, a form of COPD. She shares her story so that others with symptoms seek medical advice and keep pushing, because getting a diagnosis can take a long time.
quote: People don’t understand what a lung condition can take away from you

name: Mascha van Oers
headline: Speaking up for patients with a fifth of her lung capacity
summary: Mascha lives with very severe COPD. Ahead of World COPD Day she spoke about how she learned of her diagnosis and why awareness and patient voices matter, including in training for health professionals.
quote: I have COPD GOLD 4 with a lung capacity of about 20%.

name: Ian
headline: From competitive sport to pulmonary rehabilitation
summary: Ian was an active handyman who played competitive sport into his forties. More than 12 years after his COPD diagnosis, he goes to an exercise class twice a week and volunteers to help others recognise their symptoms.
quote: Living with COPD is a day-to-day proposition.

name: Sheryl Jones
headline: Support from specialist nurses changed how she lives with emphysema
summary: Sheryl, 67, has had severe asthma all her life and was later diagnosed with emphysema. After a frightening collapse, specialist nurses gave her practical advice and emotional support, and she now feels far less stressed about managing her symptoms.
quote: The nurses taught me ways to live with emphysema.

name: Barbara
headline: Finding people who understand
summary: Living with bronchiectasis and COPD, Barbara felt alone until an online search led her to a patient organisation. Webinars and support groups connected her with others in the same situation and changed her outlook.
quote: Before Lung Foundation Australia, I didn’t know a single person with my condition
